back: Shows the opening balance, the changes (share issues, profit, dividends paid, transfers) and the closing balance of each part of equity.
Statement of changes in equity, deducted from retained earnings (retained profits). Never in the income statement.
Income statement, as a finance cost after profit from operations; any unpaid amount is a current liability.
Opening retained earnings + profit for the year − dividends paid − transfers to reserves.

front: Effect of a transfer to the general reserve
back: Moves profit from retained earnings to the general reserve; total equity is unchanged.
An expense in the income statement (directors are employees), unlike partners' salaries.

front: Proposed final dividend at the year end
back: Not deducted in this year's statements; it is deducted in the year it is paid.
Gross profit (plus other income) less operating expenses, before finance costs.
